body.x: AFS INC. (CEO Tae Hee Kim) announced its participation in CES 2025, which will be held in Las Vegas from January 7 to 10. AFS, a company founded to benefit humanity through technology and execution, is introducing its cutting-edge product, AFS 3D, to redefine hair loss diagnosis and treatment.

AFS 3D utilizes 360-degree rotational imaging technology to scan hair conditions precisely and incorporates its proprietary AI solution, AFSS, to automatically analyze hair density, thickness, and count. The device also features microscopic imaging capabilities to understand a patient’s condition comprehensively. This enables the creation of precise, patient-specific treatment plans, reducing unnecessary costs and maximizing treatment efficiency.

AFS emphasizes that the collaboration of medical professionals, medical device distributors, AI engineers, and hardware specialists has resulted in a solution tailored to real patient needs. The technology delivers actionable, reliable, and effective outcomes that differentiate it in the market.

AFS 3D has already gained recognition, being named a CES 2025 Innovation Award honoree ahead of the event. The system leverages 360-degree rotational imaging and AI analysis to evaluate hair follicles precisely. The device offers user-friendly features such as automatic focus adjustment and a one-touch capture process. Adjustable internal lighting ensures consistent imaging conditions, enhancing data reliability. According to AFS, this innovation transforms hair transplant surgeries and hair loss treatments by reducing medical costs and improving patients’ quality of life.

body.cap: | Internal structure of AFS 3D featuring four rotating cameras | Photo by AFS

body.x: AFS 3D has four internal cameras capable of 360-degree rotational imaging, capturing up to 500 high-resolution images per session. The entire imaging process is completed in approximately one minute. The device includes a touch display that integrates all imaging and processing functions to enhance usability, eliminating the need for external devices or additional steps. The device also features a motorized lift to adjust height to the patient’s stature, ensuring consistent imaging quality. External variables such as ambient lighting are controlled with blackout curtains, creating a stable imaging environment.

The design of AFS 3D emphasizes both aesthetics and functionality. The sleek, streamlined form factor is visually appealing and optimized for 360-degree imaging. Patients enter the device, which rotates cameras internally to create a CT-like scan, offering a unique user experience. The system’s design integrates seamlessly with user operations, making it convenient for patients and healthcare professionals. Its responsive controls and straightforward interface simplify the diagnostic process, enabling easy use without extensive training.

AFS has successfully commercialized AFS 3D in South Korea and is now expanding into Hong Kong, China, and Southeast Asia. It actively targets markets in North America, Japan, and emerging economies like Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia. With its high demand for digital healthcare and AI medical devices, North America offers significant growth potential. Japan is an ideal market for AFS 3D due to its strong focus on hair care and the adoption of advanced technology. Southeast Asian countries are also experiencing rapid growth in the beauty and healthcare sectors, driving demand for innovative solutions.

body.cap: | AFS CEO Tae Hee Kim | Photo by AVING News

body.x: An AFS representative stated, “We are participating in CES 2025 to showcase the innovative capabilities of AFS 3D and to establish our position as a leader in AI-driven hair loss diagnosis. We aim to demonstrate the system’s potential and secure global partnerships with key buyers and stakeholders.”

AFS plans to use CES 2025 to establish strategic collaborations, enter new markets, and enhance its global brand recognition. With its innovative technology and user-centric design, AFS 3D is poised to set new hair loss diagnostics and management standards worldwide.
